verdict.rationale: Logseq is documented as an open-source, privacy-first knowledge base. Graphs can stay local-only, with sync opted into per graph, and a community user reports self-hosting knowledge graphs for their team works well. The pack has no first-party self-hosting guide, such as building from source or deploying the web or publish SPA on your own server, so the depth of self-hosting is unproven. Missing for 10: first-party self-hosting or deployment documentation, build-from-source instructions, and independent hands-on corroboration beyond one community anecdote.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
